verdict.rationale: Browserbase's in-dashboard Optimize tool reads an Agent run's event history and suggests a better system prompt, and can turn the completed run into a reusable Stagehand script. That counts as AI-generated suggestions from the user's own run data inside the product. The scope is narrow, though: it covers agent-run optimization, not broader insights into user or business data. missing for 10: general AI insights or analytics over user data (e.g., session or extracted-data summaries), documentation of what suggestions Optimize actually produces, independent or hands-on corroboration.
